output.text: The robotics workshop filled the gymnasium with tables of wires, gears, and small motors waiting to be assembled. Assume that Isla is the lead volunteer. Sami arrived early, carrying a toolbox that rattled with every step, and greeted Vik near the registration desk. Kai took the photographs. Ben unpacked a crate of sensors and arranged them by size on a folding table. Vik is fifteen years old, a year younger than Sami, though both had signed up for the same afternoon session. Sami is in the same study group as Vik, and the two of them spent the morning comparing notes on circuit diagrams. Isla stood near the taller end of the room, easily a head above most of the younger participants, while Kai moved quietly between groups, checking equipment lists. Vik is not in the same study group as Ben, a fact that became clear only when the groups were called out for the afternoon session. Ben ranked among the fastest builders in his section, finishing his robot arm before several others had even started wiring their motors. Sami is not in the same study group as Ben, though they sat at neighboring tables and occasionally borrowed tools from one another. Kai, who had arrived slightly after Ben but before Vik, seemed unbothered by the noise of drills and servo motors buzzing across the hall. By the end of the day, the room smelled of solder and enthusiasm, and everyone compared their finished projects under the bright overhead lights before packing up for the evening.
